name: todo-list
title: Todo List
description: A list of things to do, such as an agent's plan, flat in the conversation: its title and how many are done (a bar and "2 of 5"), then the items, the one in progress in bold with a spinner, those done muted and struck through; each item's status is read out. In a PopoverContent it has no border of its own: the popover's surface its edge, out to its edges past the popover's padding.
